🎬 The Incomer (2026)

The Incomer follows Isla and Sandy, two eccentric siblings living an isolated life on a remote Scottish island, where they spend their days hunting seabirds, sharing ancient stories, and protecting their home from outsiders. Following the strict rules left behind by their father, they believe their peaceful existence must never be disturbed. However, everything changes when Daniel, an awkward government council worker, arrives with orders to remove them from the island. Determined to defend their home, the siblings go to hilarious and unexpected lengths to drive him away. But as Daniel introduces them to the strange realities of modern society, their beliefs and relationships begin to change. Starring Domhnall Gleeson, Gayle Rankin, and Grant O’Rourke, the film combines quirky humor, fantasy, and heartfelt moments while exploring family, tradition, loneliness, friendship, and the courage to embrace change.

🎭 Genre: Fantasy • Comedy • Drama

⭐ IMDb: 7.1/10

🍅 Rotten Tomatoes: 95%

⏱️ Runtime: 1h 42m • R

🎥 Director: Louis Paxton

✍️ Writer: Louis Paxton

🏆 Awards: NEXT Innovator Award at the 2026 Sundance Film Festival.

source_details.synopsis: The Incomer is a 2026 British comedy film written and directed by Louis Paxton and starring Domhnall Gleeson, Gayle Rankin, Grant O'Rourke, Emun Elliott, Michelle Gomez, and John Hannah. The film had its world premiere in the Sundance Film Festival's NEXT section in 2026, where it won the NEXT Innovator Award. The Incomer had its theatrical release in the United Kingdom and Ireland on 4 September 2026 and received positive reviews from critics.
